findings.title: [P0] Restore the `RequestOptions` export deleted from src/types.ts
findings.body: The PR removes `export interface RequestOptions { timeoutMs: number }` from `src/types.ts`, but `src/client.ts:1` still imports `RequestOptions` and `request(path, options: RequestOptions)` still uses it (including `options.timeoutMs`). Any TypeScript type-check fails unconditionally with TS2305 ("Module './types' has no exported member 'RequestOptions'") — no compiler flags avoid it — and type-erasing transpilers that preserve the named import would fail at runtime with a missing-export error. Downstream consumers importing `RequestOptions` also lose the public type. Restore the interface in `src/types.ts`, or remove all references to it in `src/client.ts`, so the two files agree.

findings.title: [P3] Remove the unused `ClientOptions` import
findings.body: `ClientOptions` is newly imported in `src/client.ts:1` but never referenced anywhere in the module. It creates a misleading dependency and is rejected by builds with `noUnusedLocals` (TS6133). Drop it unless a follow-up change actually uses it.
